notes.subject: fix(chat): clear stale error card when the agent resumes activity
notes.summary: A stale error card on a chat message is now cleared when the agent resumes producing output, such as after an automatic resume.

notes.subject: fix(edits): keep auto-approved saves out of the editor and self-recover failures
notes.summary: Auto-approved file edits no longer open editor tabs, and failed saves of the agent's own buffer now recover automatically (late-save check, one retry, revert to disk) instead of stalling on a save_editor approval.

notes.subject: feat(chat): show requested and confirmed speed tiers in request info
notes.summary: Request info now shows the selected, sent and provider-confirmed speed tier (Fast/Ultrafast) for Codex requests, including in the browser remote view, and the SDK exposes the new service tier fields.
